action_summary: Implements the round-22 top-ranked move: the deepest measured defect was that nothing is ever compressed, so experience cannot compound -- the bridge into G_t admitted only single-return bodies and reported a gain nobody computed. This round adds shape-lifting compression over the library's memory of solved programs (admission = >=2 real sites, strictly positive measured description-length gain in uncompressed canonical AST text, every rewritten site reproducing its original behaviour), fixes the bridge to admit statement bodies with honestly computed gain/sites (fabricated max(1,bytes) deleted, honest zero preserved across reload), recognises the periodic-table family from structure, and licenses a two-cycle evidence policy for new family members -- with acquire-time 2p/3p verification retained. Prediction written before measurement: a never-seen period-12 must cost strictly fewer questions with the library than cold. MEASURED: cold 59 questions / 48 evidence points; armed 35 / 24; 41% cheaper; 0 held-out failures on 57 probes for both organs; build arm reproduces the historical cold costs 14/24/34 exactly.

obs_blocker.intrinsic_or_path_specific: Intrinsic: an abstraction is only an abstraction if rewriting the corpus with it strictly reduces description length AND every rewritten site reproduces its original behaviour. Measured on this corpus, two sites do not pay for the definition (-13 bytes); compression pays from the third site. A currency in which the admitted mechanism can never measure a gain (zlib, which re-derives shared structure for free) would make admission impossible by construction.

obs_blocker.surviving_causal_blocker: The synthesis grammar does not yet SEARCH WITH admitted abstractions (they license evidence policy only); and only one family is structurally recognised. Both are the named next round.
